question: Can I get a wholesale discount for my restaurant?
expected_behavior: Not in help center: say so and offer a person; no invented discount
answer:
I don’t have information that Brightpan offers wholesale, restaurant, or bulk-order discounts.

The only discount information I found is that one discount code can be used per order, codes must be entered at checkout, and newsletter subscribers get WELCOME15 for 15% off their first order. Discount codes don’t apply to gift cards or clearance items.

If you’d like, I can connect you with the support team to ask whether any restaurant pricing is available. (Source: Discount codes)
